name: University of Health Sciences (UHS), Lahore
_note: Punjab public and private MBBS/BDS admissions run by UHS. Closing = lowest Open-merit aggregate per college in that selection list (scripts/uhs_closing.py). Program carries the sector so public and private colleges stay apart.
table_note: 2024 MDCAT was marked out of 200, 2025 out of 180; aggregates are comparable, raw test marks are not.

formulas.source_note: PM&DC (Admissions, Curriculum and Conduct) Policy and Regulations 2026, regulation 6(3): MDCAT 50%, FSc/HSSC 40%, SSC 10%. Same weights in Admissions Regulations 2025, regulation 4(3).
